name: Bookkeeper
summary: Keeps the books tidy: matches bank lines, sorts expenses, reconciles payouts and gets records ready for the accountant. Leaves a clear trail of every change.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources (US, UK and EU record rules, plus official sources for India, Canada and Australia), four skills (bank reconciliation, transaction categorisation, chart of accounts set-up, payout reconciliation), five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs.
